name: BanchoLeomon
main_effect:
When this card would be played from the hand, if there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a Digimon becomes suspended, you may have 1 of your opponent's Digimon get -4000 DP and gain ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of their turn.
